cards.ex: My grandfather is 90 years old and still hale and hearty.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom 90 yoshda va hali ham sog'lom va baquvvat.
cards.uzDef: Jismonan kuchli, sog'lom va yaxshi holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: I have a nagging pain in my lower back that won't go away.
cards.exUz: Mening belimning pastki qismida tinimsiz bezovta qiluvchi og'riq bor, u ketmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davom etadigan va bezovta qiladigan og'riq.

cards.ex: After the stroke, she was bedridden for several months.
cards.exUz: Insultdan keyin u bir necha oy davomida to'shakka mixlangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yoki zaiflik tufayli o'rnidan turolmaydigan holat.

cards.ex: This medication is just a quick fix; you need to address the underlying issue.
cards.exUz: Bu dori faqat tez yechim; siz asosiy muammoni hal qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni tez va oson hal qilish, lekin uzoq muddatli emas.

cards.ex: After a week of vacation, I'm back in the pink.
cards.exUz: Bir haftalik ta'tildan so'ng, men yana yaxshi ahvoldaman.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va baxtli, yaxshi holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's young and resilient; he'll bounce back quickly from the surgery.
cards.exUz: U yosh va chidamli; u operatsiyadan tezda tuzalib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan yoki qiyinchilikdan tezda tuzalib ketmoq.

cards.ex: I'm getting old; I wake up with aches and pains every morning.
cards.exUz: Men qarib qolyapman; har kuni ertalab og'riqlar bilan uyg'onaman.
cards.uzDef: Kichik og'riqlar, odatda mushaklarda yoki bo'g'imlarda.

cards.ex: She had to go under the knife to repair her torn ligament.
cards.exUz: U yirtilgan boylamini tuzatish uchun operatsiya stoliga yotishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Operatsiya qilinmoq, jarrohlik amaliyotini boshdan kechirmoq.

cards.ex: Rehab gave him a clean slate to start his life over.
cards.exUz: Reabilitatsiya unga hayotini qaytadan boshlash uchun toza sahifa berdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi boshlash, o'tmishdagi xatolarni unutib yangidan boshlash.

cards.ex: The athletes are fighting fit for the upcoming competition.
cards.exUz: Sportchilar bo'lajak musobaqaga jismonan tayyor.
cards.uzDef: Juda sog'lom va jismonan kuchli, har qanday vazifani bajarishga tayyor.

cards.ex: After the illness, he was a shadow of his former self.
cards.exUz: Kasallikdan so'ng u o'zining sobiq holatining soyasi edi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining avvalgi holatiga nisbatan ancha yomonlashgan holat.

cards.ex: The positive test results were a real shot in the arm for the team.
cards.exUz: Ijobiy test natijalari jamoa uchun haqiqiy rag'bat bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kayfiyatni ko'taradigan yoki yaxshilaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: My old car is really on its last legs; I need to get a new one.
cards.exUz: Mening eski mashinam haqiqatan ham oxirgi nafasda; menga yangisini olish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan chiqqan, ishlamay qolish arafasida bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: Losing his job was a harsh dose of reality for him.
cards.exUz: Ishdan ayrilish unga hayotning qattiq haqiqati bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni anglash, hayotning qiyinchiliklarini his qilish.

cards.ex: She's still in recovery from her knee surgery.
cards.exUz: U hali ham tizza operatsiyasidan keyin tuzalish jarayonida.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan yoki jarrohlikdan keyin tuzalish jarayonida bo'lish.

cards.ex: We need to nip this illness in the bud before it spreads.
cards.exUz: Biz bu kasallikni tarqalishidan oldin yo'q qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni boshlanishida yo'q qilish, oldini olish.

cards.ex: Even though it was tough, she pushed through the pain and finished the marathon.
cards.exUz: Qiyin bo'lishiga qaramay, u og'riqni o'tkazib yuborib, marafonni tugatdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, biror narsani yakuniga yetkazmoq.

cards.ex: It took him a while to get back on his feet after the accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin unga oyoqqa turish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan keyin normal hayotga qaytmoq.

cards.ex: She was a bundle of nerves before her presentation.
cards.exUz: U taqdimotdan oldin asab to'plami edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda asabiy va xavotirda bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's having a flare-up of his arthritis.
cards.exUz: Uning artriti kuchayib ketyapti.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikning yoki og'riqning birdan kuchayishi.

cards.ex: The ailing economy needs a boost.
cards.exUz: Kasal iqtisodiyot rag'batga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Kasal yoki sog'lig'i yomon bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Curing cancer is a tall order, but researchers are working on it.
cards.exUz: Saratonni davolash qiyin vazifa, lekin tadqiqotchilar bu ustida ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bajarish qiyin bo'lgan vazifa.

cards.ex: Her cancer is in remission, but she still has regular check-ups.
cards.exUz: Uning saratoni remissiyada, lekin u hali ham muntazam tekshiruvlardan o'tadi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik belgilari yo'qolgan davr, lekin kasallik hali ham mavjud bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Wearing a scarf can help ward off a cold.
cards.exUz: Sharф taqish shamollashning oldini olishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadanдир saqlanib qolmoq, oldini оlmoq.

cards.ex: There isn't a shadow of a doubt in my mind that he's innocent.
cards.exUz: Uning begunohligiga hech qanday shubham yo'q.
cards.uzDef: ozgina shubha

cards.ex: His heart attack was a wake-up call to start living a healthier lifestyle.
cards.exUz: Uning yurak xuruji sog'lom turmush tarzini boshlash uchun ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatdan ogohlantiruvchi narsa.

cards.ex: If you exercise regularly, you'll reap the benefits of improved health.
cards.exUz: Agar siz muntazam ravishda mashq qilsangiz, sog'lig'ingizning yaxshilanishidan foyda ko'rasiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror harakatning ijobiy natijalarini ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: He's not planning on kicking the bucket anytime soon.
cards.exUz: U yaqin orada oyoq uzmoqchi emas.
cards.uzDef: O'lmoq, hayotdan ko'z yummoq (ko'pincha hazilomuz ma'noda).

cards.ex: I've been feeling out of sorts all day.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni butun kun davomida xomush his qildim.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yomon his qilish, xafa bo'lish.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and stop panicking.
cards.exUz: Siz o'zingizni tutishingiz va vahima qilishingizni to'xtatishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ularni nazorat qilish, o'zingni qo'lga olish.
